grammar.topic: Common phrasal verbs (hand out, put away, fill in, look after)
explainTr: Phrasal verb = fiil + küçük kelime (out, away, in, after). Anlamı çoğu zaman kelimelerin ayrı ayrı anlamından farklıdır: hand out = dağıtmak, put away = yerine kaldırmak, fill in = doldurmak, look after = bakmak.

Bazıları ayrılabilir: hand out the papers = hand the papers out. İsim yerine zamir (them, it) gelirse mutlaka ortaya girer: hand them out (hand out them değil). Look after gibi bazıları ayrılmaz: look after the children, look after them.
Sınıfta bu kalıpları sürekli duyarsın: take out your books, line up, turn in your homework. Hepsi emir cümlesidir.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'dağıtmak' ve 'toplamak' tek kelimedir. İngilizcede fiilin yanına bir edat ekleyerek anlam değişir: hand out (dağıtmak), hand in (teslim etmek). Edatı atlarsan anlam bozulur; ezberlerken kalıbı bir bütün olarak öğren.

reading.title: An art day with Ms. Park's class
reading.text:
On Monday morning, Hafsa substituted for Ms. Park's fifth-grade class again. This time, the sub plan was longer than usual, and the class had an art project in the afternoon.

At 8:15, Hafsa signed in at the front office and picked up the key to the supply closet. In the classroom, she set up the projector and wrote the day's schedule on the whiteboard. Then the students came in. "Good morning, everyone," she said. "Please take out your notebooks and write down today's homework."

During the first lesson, Hafsa handed out a reading worksheet. "Fill in your name at the top," she said. Some students forgot their names, and everyone laughed. When the lesson ended, she asked them to turn in the papers. "Put them on my desk, please."

At eleven, it was time for the art project. Hafsa asked the students to line up and walk to the art room. Each child got paper, glue, and paint. The room was a little messy, but everyone was cheerful. After the project, Hafsa said, "Let's clean up and put the supplies away."

Mr. Brown stopped by to check on the class. "Everything looks great," he said. "Are you looking after them well?"

"I am trying," Hafsa answered. "They are very kind, and they listen carefully."

At 3:15, the parents came to pick up their children, and Hafsa waved goodbye.

writing.promptTr: Bir vekil öğretmen notu yaz: yerine geçecek öğretmene sınıfta yapılacakları anlat. hand out, put away, fill in, look after gibi phrasal verb'leri kullan.
writing.promptEn: Write a short sub note. Use phrasal verbs like hand out, put away, fill in and look after.
frames: Ask the students to fill in ...
writing.model: Dear Substitute, thank you for helping today. First, please take attendance and sign in at the office. Then hand out the math worksheets and ask the students to fill in their names. At eleven, set up the paint on the back table. After the project, ask the children to clean up and put away the supplies. Please tell them to turn in their work at the end of the day. Ms. Kim will look after the class at lunch, so you can take a break. Call the office if you need help. Thank you, Hafsa
checklistTr: En az üç phrasal verb kullandın mı?
Zamir kullandıysan ortaya koydun mu (put them away)?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
